name: Ivrea, industrial city of the 20th century
description: Ivrea is a small Piedmont town on the Dora Baltea river, where the Olivetti company made typewriters, calculators and early office computers. Between the 1930s and 1960s, leading Italian architects built a modernist ensemble here: a long factory, offices, social facilities and housing for workers. Walking its streets shows how one company tried to build a more humane kind of industrial town.
